courses.overview: 從Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲延伸至兩個相近領域；共用架構不代表相同數值、許可權或安全保證。
courses.overviewEn: Extend frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology to two neighboring areas; shared architectures do not imply equal values, privileges or guarantees.

related.title: LUMI 超級電腦架構
related.why: 兩套平臺都用 MI250X 與 HBM 分析
related.transfer: 兩套平臺都用 MI250X 與 HBM 分析
related.difference: 軟體、網路與資源政策不能直接套用
related.differenceEn: Software, networks and resource policies do not transfer unchanged

place.name: LUMI 計畫城市代表點
place.coordinateScope: 城市中心近似座標，僅作公開技術脈絡的地理代表點，不是機構地址、裝置位置、登入位置或參訪入口。研究與開源合作分散全球，並非本課所有技術都在此發明或部署。
place.coordinateScopeEn: Approximate city-center coordinates for public technical context, not institutional addresses, equipment, login locations or visitor entrances. Research and open collaboration are global; this does not locate every invention or deployment.

practice: 畫出本課與「LUMI 超級電腦架構」共用的資料／元件介面；以「兩套平臺都用 MI250X 與 HBM 分析」指出能保留的條件。
針對「軟體、網路與資源政策不能直接套用」改寫一個實驗，列出新增的輸入、單位與可辨別觀測。
將本課量化例移到新情境：沿用有根據的公式、重新指定假設並標記不能移轉的數值。
practiceEn: Draw shared data/component interfaces with lumi supercomputer architecture; use "Both analyze MI250X and HBM" to identify retained conditions.
For "Software, networks and resource policies do not transfer unchanged", redesign one experiment with new inputs, units and discriminating observations.
Transfer the quantitative example: retain justified formulas, respecify assumptions and identify nontransferable values.

related.title: 大型 MPI 平行模擬
related.why: 共同分析 GPU/節點通訊與域分解
related.whyEn: Both analyze device/node communication and decomposition
related.transfer: 共同分析 GPU/節點通訊與域分解
related.transferEn: Both analyze device/node communication and decomposition
related.difference: Frontier 另需考慮 GCD 與主機的異質路徑
related.differenceEn: Frontier additionally needs GCD and host heterogeneity

courses.summary: Frontier 超級電腦架構從Frontier 異質節點、HBM 與通訊拓撲連結介面、資料與驗收。地圖是公開研究城市的近似代表點，不代表所有工具在此製造或部署。
courses.summaryEn: Frontier supercomputer architecture connects interfaces, data and acceptance through frontier heterogeneous nodes, hbm and interconnect topology. Maps are approximate public research-city references, not claims of manufacturing or deployment.
courses.connection: 從「異質角色」到「科學驗收」，將技術定義與可反駁驗證對接。
courses.connectionEn: Connect heterogeneous roles to scientific acceptance, pairing technical definitions and falsifiable validation.

history.title: 從公開架構到原創教學模型
history.titleEn: From public architecture to original teaching models
history.text: Frontier 的公開指南揭示異質節點和系統路徑；課程以原創資料流圖及假想 roofline 分解效能。
history.textEn: Frontier public guides describe heterogeneous paths; original flows and hypothetical rooflines decompose performance.

history.year: 科教與協作 / Education and collaboration
history.title: 跨機構、跨版本的工程驗證
history.titleEn: Engineering checks across institutions and versions
history.text: 本課由原始檔案與官方介面出發，使用自製架構、算例和合成資料；城市標記只協助理解協作脈絡，不聲稱可參訪、可登入或具有現場操作許可權。
history.textEn: The course starts from original documents and official interfaces, using original architectures, examples and synthetic data. City markers provide collaboration context, not visits, logins or operational privileges.

roles.role: Frontier 的 EPYC CPU 與 Instinct MI250X GPU 供應商。

roles.businessEn: Designs EPYC/Ryzen CPUs, Instinct accelerators and (ex-Xilinx) FPGAs and adaptive SoCs.

courses.connection: 從「Frontier 超級電腦架構」的材料、設備、設計、量測或系統整合問題，延伸查閱下列公司與機構的官方資料；這是教材關聯，不代表合作、採購、背書或投資建議。
courses.connectionEn: Explore official information from companies and institutions related to the materials, equipment, design, measurement or system integration in Frontier supercomputer architecture. This is a learning association, not a partnership, procurement, endorsement or investment advice.
